info.title: Bytewise.Cli
info.description: The bytewise operator CLI — a thin, scriptable client for the Bytewise Solutions operator-tooling API (login/pairing, project monitoring reads, crash/feedback triage writes; --json machine output with stable exit codes for CI).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
bytewise — scriptable operator client for the Bytewise Solutions API.

Credentials: 'bytewise login' pairs this machine via a web-minted CliClient pairing code and stores the token in the OS credential store (BYTEWISE_CLI_TOKEN overrides it for CI; keep CI tokens read-only-scoped).
Environment: BYTEWISE_API_ORIGIN, BYTEWISE_PROJECT, BYTEWISE_CLI_TOKEN, BYTEWISE_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE.
Config file: ~/.config/bytewise/config (origin/project defaults; 'bytewise config show').
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 validation/usage, 3 auth, 4 forbidden/insufficient scope, 5 not found, 6 rate limited.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --origin
options.description: API origin URL (default: $BYTEWISE_API_ORIGIN, then the configured origin). HTTPS required; plain HTTP only for loopback development.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug for project-scoped commands (default: $BYTEWISE_PROJECT, then the configured project).

options.name: --json
options.description: Stable machine-readable output: a versioned JSON envelope on stdout; errors as JSON on stderr. [default: False]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Pair this machine: mint a CliClient pairing code on the web Security page (bound to the printed challenge), paste it here, and the CLI exchanges it for a stored token. The code is read from stdin, never a command argument.

options.name: --print-token
options.description: Print the minted token once (default: store silently and never print it). [default: False]

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Revoke the current credential server-side and delete it locally.

options.name: --force
options.description: Also revoke an env-supplied BYTEWISE_CLI_TOKEN (refused by default — it may be a shared CI credential). [default: False]

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the authenticated operator account and credential profile.

commands.name: projects
commands.description: Project discovery.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the projects this credential's account is a member of.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Portfolio and per-project dashboard reads.

commands.name: portfolio
commands.description: Cross-project portfolio cards (account-level).

commands.name: summary
commands.description: Per-project dashboard summary tiles.

commands.name: crashes
commands.description: Crash issues: list, detail, human triage, releases.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Open (and recently resolved) crash issues.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Full detail for one crash issue: exception, frames, breadcrumbs, tags.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: The crash issue's external id (from 'crashes list').

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Human triage of a crash issue (requires the analytics.triage write scope). Omitted fields stay unchanged.

options.name: --status
options.description: New internal status (e.g. open, investigating, resolved, muted).

options.name: --severity
options.description: New severity (e.g. low, medium, high, critical).

options.name: --notes
options.description: Operator notes for the issue.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: The crash issue's external id (from 'crashes list').

commands.name: releases
commands.description: Per-release crash-free rates and sessions.

commands.name: alerts
commands.description: Crash alert configuration (show/enable/disable/rearm).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Current crash-alert configuration.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable crash alerting (requires the analytics.configure write scope).

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable crash alerting (requires the analytics.configure write scope).

commands.name: rearm
commands.description: Re-arm the crash alert window (requires the analytics.configure write scope).

options.name: --days
options.description: Re-arm window in days (server default when omitted).

commands.name: revenue
commands.description: Revenue reads.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Commerce revenue: collected/outstanding by currency, counts, refunds, trials.

commands.name: stores
commands.description: App-store revenue: daily series, top products, report coverage.

commands.name: stores
commands.description: App-store reads beyond revenue.

commands.name: vitals
commands.description: Store vitals (crash/ANR rates) for one registered store app.

options.name: --app-id
options.description: The registered store app id (required by the contract).

commands.name: feedback
commands.description: User feedback: list, human triage, resolve/reopen, replies.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List feedback items.

options.name: --state
options.description: Filter by state (e.g. open, resolved).

options.name: --category
options.description: Filter by category.

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Human triage of a feedback item (requires the feedback.manage write scope). Omitted fields stay unchanged.

options.name: --status
options.description: New status.

options.name: --category
options.description: New category.

options.name: --assignee
options.description: Assign to this operator user id.

options.name: --notes
options.description: Admin notes.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Mark a feedback item resolved (requires the feedback.manage write scope).

commands.name: reopen
commands.description: Reopen a resolved feedback item (requires the feedback.manage write scope).

commands.name: replies
commands.description: List the e-mail replies sent for a feedback item.

commands.name: reply
commands.description: E-mail a reply to the feedback author (requires the feedback.manage write scope).

options.name: --body
options.description: Reply body (read from stdin when omitted — pipe-friendly).

commands.name: config
commands.description: Local CLI configuration (origin/project defaults, credential profiles).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the effective configuration and stored credential profiles (never the tokens).

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a default (origin or project).

commands.name: unset
commands.description: Remove a default (origin or project).

commands.name: email
commands.description: Local email-domain checks.

commands.name: dns-check
commands.description: Check a sending domain's SPF, DMARC, and DKIM DNS records (read-only DoH lookups; validates record syntax/policy and reports missing/weak records). Exits non-zero on any FAIL.

options.name: --domain
options.description: The sending domain to check (e.g. mail.example.com).

options.name: --from-email
options.description: Derive the domain from this address when --domain is omitted (e.g. no-reply@example.com).

options.name: --dkim-selector
options.description: DKIM selector(s) to check (repeatable), e.g. s1 s2 for SendGrid or the Resend domainkey selector.
